text:
ashley: Heads-up — getting a noisy run of embed-api 5xx alerts tied to a client migration. Proposing a 30m snooze on alerts/embed-api-5xx-rate while we throttle the offending client and roll it back. Asking eng-sre for quick 👍 or objections.

sam: Which exact alert name and runbook? Can you paste the dashboard + query so I can eyeball metrics?

ashley: Alert is alerts/embed-api-5xx-rate. Grafana dashboard: https://grafana.redwood.com/d/embeds/embed-api-overview?orgId=1&var-service=embed-api.
Datadog logs query: "service:embed-api status:5xx" -> https://app.datadoghq.com/logs?query=service%3Aembed-api%20status%3A5xx
Runbook: https://wiki.redwood.com/runbooks/embed-api-errors

ashley: Quick query snippet I ran in Datadog:
```
source:logs "service:embed-api" | status:5xx | rollup(sum, 1m)
```
Shows a ~10x spike starting 1880123300 from a single client_id.

maria: Do traces point to internal cascade or client retries? I'm also seeing KV cache miss rate up around the same time. That could amplify errors.

ashley: Checked Jaeger traces: https://jaeger.redwood.com/trace/abcd1234 — looks like a retry storm (client hitting timeout and retrying). Plan: 1) mute alerts for 30m, 2) apply edge throttle for that client_id, 3) rollback problematic deployment, 4) monitor. Also proposing temporary threshold bump 1% -> 3% for a 15m evaluation window so the alert doesn't re-fire during mitigation.

dave: Fine with a 30m emergency mute. Prefer we run the mute command so it's auditable and we have exact timestamps. Can you run: `/alerts mute alerts/embed-api-5xx-rate --duration=30m --reason='client flood during migration'` and paste the output here?

ashley: Ran it, output below:
```json
{ "status": "muted", "alert": "alerts/embed-api-5xx-rate", "muted_by": "ashley", "until_unix": "1880125256" }
``` :thumbsup:
I'll also kick off a follow-up ticket to evaluate permanent alert tuning if this recurs.

sam: Please add a short blameless note in #incidents and tag platform.eng for a follow-up. Also don't let the snooze exceed 30m.

incidents-bot: Alert mute recorded by ashley. Incident link: https://incidents.redwood.com/INC-4581

maria: LGTM, watching dashboards for the next 30m. If error rate doesn't drop after throttle+rollback, we'll escalate to infra for deeper heap/GC traces.

dave: Thanks — if anyone sees another burst, let's cancel the mute and handle it as a live incident.
